complexity_note: Depth 2-4 and at most 4/8/16 leaves. XGB depthwise, LGBM leafwise with depth cap, CAT oblivious symmetric trees are approximately bounded, not capacity-equivalent. XGB Hessian floor and LGBM count+Hessian floors differ; CAT SymmetricTree does not support the same minimum-leaf-count gate. Conservative depth/L2/stopping controls are used rather than claiming exact equivalence.
